meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会一直盯住一个 pull request:循环检查 CI 状态、评论和 review 线程,发现真实问题就提交修复并推送,直到检查通过、没有待处理评论和未解决线程才停。
howto.when: 当你让它 babysit、monitor 一个 PR,或持续盯着 PR 的评论、review、CI 直到所有可处理问题都解决时触发。

say.text: 帮我 babysit #123 这个 PR,直到可以合并
say.note: 它会循环检查 CI、评论和 review 线程。

say.text: 继续盯着这个 PR 的 CI 和未解决的 review 评论
say.note: 发现真实问题会改代码并推送。

say.text: 把已经修好的 review 线程标记为 resolved
say.note: 只在验证代码确实改好后才会解决。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude stays on a pull request: it loops over CI checks, comments and review threads, fixes real issues in focused commits, pushes, and stops only when checks pass with no actionable comments or unresolved threads left.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to babysit or monitor a pull request, or to keep checking its comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #123 until it's ready to merge
say_en.note: It loops on CI, comments, and review threads.

say_en.text: Keep watching this PR's CI and unresolved review comments
say_en.note: It fixes real issues and pushes commits.

say_en.text: Mark the review threads I already fixed as resolved
say_en.note: Only after verifying the code addresses them.
